QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Stone Colossus
QuestInfo.0:
The Great Spirit Guwaru has lost his powers. He claims that spirits around the world are gathering at a new life form... a Stone Colossus in Minar Forest.\r\n\r\n

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 150 - 155\r\n
- #eRoute#n\r\n
   1) Accept the quest, 'A Giant of a Rumor'\r\n
   2) Travel to the Exploration Site in South Leafre's Minar Forest\r\n\r\n

- #eFinal Reward#n  \r\n
